subject: Security onboarding: training attestations + offboard chain of custody
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@brightbank.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit request: samples for onboarding/offboarding controls (SOC2 scope)

Marcus / Monica,

As part of BrightBank's SOC2 readiness review of vendor controls, can you provide sample artifacts for employee onboarding and offboarding covering the last 18 months? We're looking for: 

- Training completion evidence (security awareness + data handling) for a representative cohort (minimum 20 records). Prefer CSV export with name, employee ID (redacted), training module, completion timestamp, and trainer id.
- Background check/redaction examples (sample 3 files, fully redacted where appropriate).
- Chain-of-custody or offboard checklist showing steps taken when accounts are removed (includes ticket ids and timestamps).
- Proof of access removal: IAM deprovision events or logs for at least 5 departed employees.
- Signed HR attestation that the above artifacts are accurate and that redaction policy was followed.

Please redact PII as necessary and indicate redaction method. Deadline for initial packet: EOD Sep 15, 2026 (BrightBank timezone). If you prefer, upload artifacts to the Drive link in our intake ticket (HBX-3421).

Thanks,
Alex Turner
IT Audit Lead, BrightBank
[Attachment: brightbank_audit_checklist.pdf]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit request: samples for onboarding/offboarding controls (SOC2 scope)

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear checklist. We'll assemble a compact packet and upload to the Drive folder by EOD Sep 15. Initial plan: 

1) Attached: training_certificates.csv (20 sample rows, employee IDs redacted to hashed values).
2) We'll upload three redacted background check PDFs to the folder; each will include a short redaction log describing which fields were removed.
3) Offboard chain-of-custody: we'll produce offboard_chain_of_custody.pdf (ticket references + timestamps).

Couple of quick clarifying questions: 
- For the IAM deprovision proof, do you prefer raw CloudTrail/Syslog exports or a filtered CSV summarizing event, actor, and timestamp? We can do both but want to align with your tooling.
- Is a scanned/e-signed HR attestation acceptable, or do you require original-signed physical documents?

Marking Monica and Kim to coordinate uploads (Monica: can you confirm which leaver cohort we should sample — voluntary vs. contractor exits?).

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Ops (acting), Redwood Inference
[Attachment: training_certificates.csv]
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit request: samples for onboarding/offboarding controls (SOC2 scope)

Alex / Marcus — quick update from HR/security side: 

- Sample cohort: 12 full-time leavers and 8 contractors (mixed reasons) between Jan 2025–Aug 2026. That gives coverage across voluntary, role elimination, and contractor end dates.
- IAM evidence: we'll upload a filtered CSV (access_removal_export.csv) with event_id, user_hash, resource, action (remove/disable), actor, timestamp, and ticket_ref. We'll also include full raw logs in the Drive folder for your ingestion if needed.
- Backgrounds: we'll include three redacted samples in redacted_backgrounds_sample.zip and a short redaction_manifest.txt describing redaction rules applied.
- Offboard checklist: offboard_chain_of_custody.pdf will show ticket flow (Helpdesk -> HR -> IAM) and include the checklist used for each sample.
- HR attestation: HR will sign and upload HR_attestation.pdf (e-signed ok).

I've staged everything in the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBf-example-artifacts (permissions set to view for audits@brightbank.com). If you need alternate access, tell us and we'll add the service account.

Next steps: I'll upload the offboard_chain_of_custody.pdf and redacted_backgrounds_sample.zip within 90 minutes, then follow with access_removal_export.csv and the e-signed HR_attestation.pdf.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior People Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: offboard_chain_of_custody.pdf]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 21:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit request: samples for onboarding/offboarding controls (SOC2 scope)

Alex — confirmed. We've uploaded the requested artifacts to the Drive folder and set view access for audits@brightbank.com. Summary of uploaded items: 

- training_certificates.csv (20 rows) [Attachment stub]
- redacted_backgrounds_sample.zip (3 redacted PDFs + redaction_manifest.txt) [Attachment stub]
- offboard_chain_of_custody.pdf (sample checklist with ticket refs) [Attachment stub]
- access_removal_export.csv (filtered CSV of IAM deprovision events) [Attachment stub]
- HR_attestation.pdf (e-signed by Kimberly Park, Head of People Ops) [Attachment stub]

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBf-example-artifacts

If you prefer we also deliver a signed spreadsheet with record hashes cross-walking to ticket ids for your evidence binder, let us know and Monica will prepare it.

Thanks for the review window — happy to hop on a short call tomorrow if you want a walk-through.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Ops (acting), Redwood Inference
[Attachment: access_removal_export.csv, HR_attestation.pdf]
